correctness.rationale: For g,h in M2(k), D_{g,h}={X:(gh-I)X=X(gh-I)=0} equals 0, a rank-one-matrix line, or all M2(k) depending on rank(gh-I)=2,1,0. Sandwich map hXg has inverse gXh on the partner domain, preserves trace via tr(ghX)=tr X, and rank<=1. Full-domain elements have gh=I and are PGL2(k) conjugations. A rank-one idempotent line has a unique nonzero trace-one idempotent; trace-preserving maps between two such lines are uniquely determined and generated by g=Eu,h=u^-1 E. For nilpotent lines, g=(I+N)u,h=u^-1 maps N to any prescribed nonzero nilpotent M via conjugacy, yielding k^× maps per ordered pair of nilpotent lines. Distinct line types have only zero intersection, so all possible composites close. Over F_q, q(q+1) idempotent lines and q+1 nilpotent lines give exact |Inn|=q(q^2-1)+q^2(q+1)^2+(q+1)^2(q-1)+1. Independent all 256 (g,h) pairs over F2 yield 52 unique partial generators, with domain histogram 1:1, 2:45, 16:6; source verify.py under artifacts (blob 99dc782bbc3bada160df4f79482a34dfd589ef4e) checks q2 and q3. Analytic rank/traces establish the arbitrary-field statement, not finite cases.
